decisions.reason: The referenced arrangement concerns the battery JST and board JST, not the USB-C connector or its sourcing constraints.
Connector placement and mechanical-clearance conditions do not change the battery-protection modes or cutoff behavior.
The source decision does not change the requirement to connect the battery NTC through J_BAT.
The connector arrangement does not affect the SK6812 charge-status indicator, GPIO assignment, or separate-LED rule.
The mechanical connector constraints do not alter boost-converter enable control or the switched 5V load behavior.
The source decision does not modify the requirement for TVS-based ESD protection.
Battery-connector placement and mounting-hole clearance do not change I2C cable length, clock speed, pull-up resistance, or pull-up location.
The source establishes mechanical arrangement constraints and does not change component availability or fallback-sourcing requirements.
